text:
Eve: Quick debrief from the MerchantPilot readout — execs liked accuracy improvements but asked for a clear plan for cold-start mitigation and an explicit commercial commitment for scaling.
Marcus: I captured the ask: pilot extension + committed capacity. They want concrete SLAs and a 30-day operational runbook.
Priya: Final eval snapshot (post-normalization): intent F1=0.894, refund FPR=2.2%, steady p95=238ms, cold-start 95th=470ms, cost approx $0.090/1k tokens. Uploaded CSV to S3.
Hiro: Cold-start is from worker spin-up + KV cache cold misses. Warmup reduces steady p95 by ~18%. We should show a 3-panel slide: baseline, with prompt fixes, with warmup.
Selena: Security Q from their CISO: single-tenant key separation, access audit trail, and data purge guarantees. We can commit to per-customer KMS keys for Dedicated and 90-day log retention by default.
Ravi: Commercial proposal: recommended package = Dedicated 4x (A10 equiv) reserved, $70k/mo + $12k onboarding one-time. Alternate conservative = 2x reserved $47k/mo. Include expected unit cost delta and 3-month conversion milestones.
Eve: Keep the expansion ask concise: one slide with the price, SLA bullets, and an example cost savings calc for 1M tokens.
Priya: Quick note on fixes applied: 1) prompt trimming (removed metadata lines), 2) added one-shot exemplar per intent, 3) normalised currency tokens. Minimal prompt diff below:
```
- [META id=mp-999] amount=$12.00 currency=USD msg="Refund request"
+ msg="Refund request"
+ example: "Intent: request_refund"
```
Priya: That change fixed several tokenization edgecases and reduced token overhead ~6%.
Hiro: Ops plan for cold-start: pre-warm on deploy, short-lived worker pool during peak windows, and fallback route to lightweight model for first-200ms. We'll include a small runbook.
Selena: Also include the KMS policy snippet and a note: pen-test scheduled within 45 days on request; SOC2 report already available.
Marcus: Buyer asked about EU data locality. We can offer Private VPC in eu-central (Frankfurt) with region pinning and separate billing for that region. Add delta in appendix.
Ravi: I'll put the commercial slide together and show simple ROI numbers: expected token cost drop from $0.12 to $0.085 at scale for their workload.
Eve: Action items and owners: Priya -> attach final CSV and sample prompt diff; Hiro -> add warmup runbook + latency charts; Selena -> KMS policy + compliance slide; Ravi -> pricing slide + 2 contract options; Marcus -> follow-up email and timeline.
ci-bot: pipeline: merchantpilot-readout-followup build succeeded (artifact: s3://ci-artifacts/merchantpilot/readout-followup.pdf).
Eve: I'll send the follow-up to their execs tonight with a proposed calendar for the 30-day SLA pilot start (target next Monday). Anything else?
Priya: One more datapoint: A/B test vs smaller model for cold-start fallback reduced first-second failure rate by 40% in sim. I'll add that to the risks/mitigations slide.
Marcus: Great. If the buyer signs the commitment we'll need a named SE and an escalation contact. Ravi can you confirm who will be SE?
Ravi: I can cover initial SE duties and hand off to onboarding team after week two.
Eve: Perfect. I'll draft the follow-up email and share for review. Meeting closed. :white_check_mark:
